title: Rabbi Chiyya, Father of Rabbi Acha
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in the old Tanchuma, Shelach. But Tanchuma Buber reads “Rabbi Tanchuma bar Abba in the name of Rabbi Chanina, father of Rabbi Acha bar Chanina,” and so it is in Bamidbar Rabbah 17:2, except that there it reads “his brother”; Hyman proposes “his father.”

notes.text: The consulted Buber Tanchuma gives Chanina as Acha’s father, whereas Bamidbar Rabbah gives “his brother.” Hyman says the latter should read “his father.” Neither wording changes the supplied heading Chiyya.
